dict.string: Buntini uses your microphone only while you hold push to talk. Audio is transcribed locally.
Buntini uses only the apps you allow in Settings → Apps: it reads them on this Mac, and adds or drafts things only after you approve each one.
Buntini shows your events when you ask and in your morning brief, only after you allow Calendar in Settings → Apps.

Buntini lists your open reminders when you ask and in your morning brief, only after you allow Reminders in Settings → Apps.
